description: Lists calendars accessible through the connected user's CalendarList, returning IDs and user-specific metadata such as access role, color, visibility, selection, and reminders. Hidden calendars are omitted unless show_hidden is true; min_access_role and show_deleted provide additional filtering. Continue with page_token until next_page_token is absent; for incremental synchronization, pass next_sync_token back as sync_token. Use returned IDs, not display names, with event actions, and use GOOGLECALENDAR_GET_CALENDAR for canonical metadata about one known calendar.

page_token.title: Page Token
page_token.description: Token for the page of results to return, from a previous response.
page_token.human_parameter_description: If you’re continuing from a previous list, paste the page token here to get the next set of calendars. Leave blank to start from the beginning.

sync_token.title: Sync Token
sync_token.description: Sync token from a previous list request to get only changed entries; showDeleted, showHidden, and pageToken are ignored if provided. Also ignores minAccessRole. An HTTP 410 Gone response means the token has expired; perform a full resync by omitting sync_token.
sync_token.human_parameter_description: Provide a sync token from a previous run to fetch only calendars that changed since then. Use this for faster incremental updates.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum calendars to return on one page. Google defaults to 100 and allows at most 250. Follow next_page_token until absent to enumerate every accessible calendar.
max_results.human_parameter_description: How many calendars to show in one batch. Increase this to see more at once (up to 250).

show_hidden.title: Show Hidden
show_hidden.description: Include calendars not typically shown in the UI.
show_hidden.human_parameter_description: Include calendars that are hidden in your calendar view. Enable this if you’re looking for calendars you’ve hidden.

show_deleted.title: Show Deleted
show_deleted.description: Include deleted calendars in the result.
show_deleted.human_parameter_description: Turn this on to include calendars you’ve deleted in the results. Most people can leave this off.

min_access_role.title: Min Access Role
min_access_role.description: Minimum access role for returned calendars: 'freeBusyReader', 'reader', 'writerWithoutPrivateAccess', 'writer', or 'owner'. freeBusyReader calendars expose only free/busy slots. Omit this filter to include every accessible role.
min_access_role.human_parameter_description: Only include calendars where you have at least this level of access. For example, choose 'owner' to see just calendars you own.

type.title: Type
type.description: Notification type: eventCreation, eventChange, eventCancellation, eventResponse, or agenda.

DefaultReminder.title: DefaultReminder

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes before event start to trigger reminder (0-40320).

DefaultReminder.description: A default reminder for calendar events.

CalendarListEntry.title: CalendarListEntry

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: Whether the calendar is hidden from the calendar list.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: Whether the calendar has been deleted from the calendar list.

primary.title: Primary
primary.description: Whether this is the user's primary calendar.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: Whether calendar events appear on the calendar UI.

dataOwner.title: Data Owner
dataOwner.description: Email of the calendar owner. Set only for secondary calendars.

accessRole.title: Access Role
accessRole.description: User's access role: freeBusyReader, reader, writer, or owner.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view this calendar in the Google Calendar web interface.

summaryOverride.title: Summary Override
summaryOverride.description: User's custom title for the calendar.

defaultReminders.title: Default Reminders
defaultReminders.description: Default reminders for events on this calendar.

conferenceProperties.title: Conference Properties
conferenceProperties.description: Conference-related properties for events on this calendar.

autoAcceptInvitations.title: Auto Accept Invitations
autoAcceptInvitations.description: Whether calendar automatically accepts invitations. Only valid for resource calendars.

CalendarListEntry.description: Represents a calendar in the user's calendar list.

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.title: Allowed Conference Solution Types
allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description: Conference solution types allowed: eventHangout, eventNamedHangout, or hangoutsMeet.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: List of notification configurations for this calendar.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: List of calendar entries with full calendar details.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view the calendar list in the Google Calendar web interface. None for collection-level list responses.

next_page_token.title: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results. Pass this as page_token in the next request. Absent when there are no more pages.

next_sync_token.title: Next Sync Token
next_sync_token.description: Token for incremental sync. Pass this as sync_token in a future request to get only changed entries. Only present on the last page of results.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
